race_courses.name: Manassas National Battlefield Park, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the Brawner Farm Loop Trail just east of the Brawner Farm lot. One lap: a short way south-east on the Brawner Farm Loop Trail, north-east to the Brawner Farm bridle loop, then clockwise round the bridle loop (shared with horses): south towards Lee Highway without reaching it, west, north and east along the far edges of the farm, and back south-west on the trail through the middle of the farm. No road is crossed.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the Brawner Farm Interpretive Center lot, reached from Pageland Lane. Walk east on the Brawner Farm Loop Trail; the start line is a short way along it.
